title: litmus timeline record, format_version 1
description: One JSON Lines object from a node's timeline.jsonl: the temporal view of a run. Every physical line of the file is one complete instance of this schema. The object stays open so a consumer accepts fields added within version 1 by a later release; docs/inspector-json.md carries the policy.

format_version.description: Timeline-record schema version, carried on every line so a consumer can refuse a version mid-file.

scope.description: Root-to-emitting-node path, inclusive. Inline cases roll into the nearest owning ancestor's file but keep their own scope.

message.description: Fully rendered log message. Newlines stay escaped within the JSON line.

artifact_name.description: Captured artifact name, or 'result' for the root result.

artifact_path.description: Absolute path of the published artifact, or of the root result.json.

artifact_type.description: Captured artifact type, or 'run-result' for the root result.

artifact_timestamp.description: The evidence timestamp; for the root result, its publication time.

utcTimestamp.description: Timezone-aware UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 form ending in Z.
